brand.name: Gold Star
brand.description: Originally introduced 1995, dormant for years. Revived 2024 as a Limited Edition supporting the Navy SEAL Gold Star Program. Went into full regular production starting March 2025, with wider retail rollout after PCA trade show, April 2025.
brand.notes: Made at Tabacalera William Ventura, Dominican Republic; ~1 year post-roll aging.

line.name: Gold Star (regular production, 2025)
line.filler: Dominican (Ligero, Criollo '98, Corojo '98) blended with Connecticut Broadleaf
line.notes: Boxes of 20. Differs from the 2024 LE version primarily in binder (Sumatra vs. Ecuadoran) and a higher ligero/broadleaf ratio.

research_notes: Mac filenames use both 'Gs-' and 'Star-' prefixes for the same 3 vitolas (single-stick vs. box-open photo sets), not 6 distinct products.
